name: pod-pricing
description: POD 定价助手：按成本、平台费、运费和市场价带反解建议售价，起量阶段默认每单 1–3 元；可把价格写回 listing-spec.json。

description_i18n.en: POD pricing assistant: back-solves a listing price from cost, platform fees, shipping and a market price band, defaulting to a 1–3 CNY contribution for volume launch; patches listing-spec.json.
description_i18n.zh-CN: POD 定价助手：按成本、平台费、运费和市场价带反解建议售价，起量阶段默认每单 1–3 元；可把价格写回 listing-spec.json。
